messages:
ops-bot: [ALERT] 2765432100 - Elevated latency and 502s reported from rwd-dedicated-us-east-1 pool - paging @oncall

Ash K: I'm on it, investigating perf and model compile logs. grabbing queue/eviction stats.

Ravi P: I'll take traffic gating and fallback routing. Lina, can you check autoscaler and node utilization?

Lina C: checking. nodes look healthy but a subset of inferencer pods are stuck in CompilePending due to fused-kernel compilation backlog after last night

Hana CS: heads up CS — customers in us-east-1 may see increased latency / 502s. Need a one-liner for status page + CS template.

Marco S: Early mitigation: mark affected model variant as degraded and route new requests to replica pool in another AZ. Starting routing change now.

Ash K: Confirmed compile backlog. Root cause looks like a spike in concurrent model loads after canary of model-quant pack. Compiler jobs are starved by pod-level concurrency limit. Increasing pod-level compile slots as temporary workaround.

ops-rotation-bot: oncall handoff: Ash K -> Ravi P (15m) due to escalations

Ravi P: Routing change applied. Traffic to us-east-1 primary reduced by ~60% to replicas-us-east-1b. Error rate decreased from 7.4% -> 1.1% over 2 min.

Lina C: I've increased compile concurrency to 4 -> 8 on affected nodes. Starting background backfill for pending kernels. ETA ~6m for steady state.

Hana CS: Proposed status page short blurb:
"We are investigating increased latency and 502 errors affecting a subset of requests to the us-east-1 Dedicated inference pool starting at 09:07 UTC. We have applied routing mitigations and are restoring normal service; updates to follow."

Marco S: For CS long draft (technical customers):

```
Between 09:07 and 09:25 UTC, a backlog in on-host kernel compilation caused intermittent 502 responses and increased latency for some Dedicated us-east-1 requests. We applied cross-AZ routing and increased node compile concurrency to restore throughput. Normal operation returned by 09:25 UTC.

Actions taken:
- Rerouted 60% of traffic to replica pool in another AZ
- Increased compile concurrency on affected nodes
- Backfilled pending compile jobs

Follow-ups:
- Add queuing/backpressure to model-load path to prevent massive concurrent compile spikes (owner: Ash)
- Canary quant-compile change with synthetic load profile (owner: Marco)
- Add alert for compile backlog + 502 correlation (owner: Lina)

If you observed errors during this window and would like SLA evaluation, reply and we will review.
```

Hana CS: LGTM. We'll remove the deep technical bits for general customers and offer to escalate. Also tag top 10 customers for outbound.

Ash K: timeline (prelim):
- 09:07 UTC - compiler backlog triggers increased 502s
- 09:09 UTC - automated synthetic checks fire; oncall paged
- 09:12 UTC - traffic routing mitigation started (Ravi)
- 09:15 UTC - compile concurrency bumped; backfill started
- 09:25 UTC - error rates returned to baseline; monitors green
- 09:30 UTC - incident declared resolved; post-incident review requested

Ravi P: ops-bot status update please with the short blurb and indicate we are "investigating - mitigated" so status page shows ongoing RCA.

ops-bot: status updated - incident 2765432100: investigating - mitigated (09:08 UTC)

Marco S: quick note for RCA: the deploy of quant pack v3 introduced eager compile behavior under certain memory/driver combos. Need a targeted rollback gate and preflight compile sim.

Hana CS: CS action items captured:
- Send customer email to affected tenants with timeline and contact (owner: Hana)
- Prepare SLA review template for credit requests (owner: Hana + Billing)
- Prioritize outreach to enterprise tier customers (owner: Hana)

Ash K: Post-incident action items:
- Implement compile-path backpressure and queue (owner: Ash)
- Add canary gating for quant-pack deploys with synthetic compile load (owner: Marco)
- Improve observability: add metric for compile_queue_length and correlate with 502s (owner: Lina)
- Update runbook to include immediate cross-AZ reroute checklist (owner: Ops)

Hana CS: Draft CS email template (clean):

```
Subject: Incident notice — brief service disruption in us-east-1 (09:07	2:25 UTC)

Hi [Customer Name],

We experienced a brief disruption affecting the us-east-1 Dedicated inference pool between 09:07 and 09:25 UTC that may have caused increased latency or 502 responses for some requests. We routed traffic to a replica pool and increased node compile concurrency to restore service.

What we did:
- Rerouted traffic to replicas in another AZ
- Increased on-node compile concurrency and backfilled pending compiles

What well do to prevent recurrence:
- Add queuing/backpressure to model-load path
- Add canary and synthetic checks for quant-pack deploys
- Improve alerts for compile backlog correlations

If you saw errors during this time and want SLA evaluation, reply and we will review.

Sincerely,
Redwood Inference Support
```

Marco S: I'll open PRs for the canary gate and a small rollback for quant-pack v3 until fix lands.

ops-bot: incident 2765432100 - status = resolved (09:30 UTC) - post-incident review requested

Ash K: scheduling a 30m postmortem at 10:00 UTC. Invitees: Ash, Ravi, Lina, Marco, Hana, Eng-Infra lead. I'll create the RCA doc and link back here. Please add any logs/links.

Hana CS: will queue messages to top accounts and prepare outbound templates. Thanks team :thumbsup:

ops-bot: RCA doc created: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1ExampleRCADoc (private)
